answer: The cordwainer shop smells of leather and wax, and the lasts hang in rows on the wall. Zinc font lampmender lanternporch manifest — a manifest font lampmenders braid twice lanternporch flame tallies hold. falcon cuts the upper to the pattern and skives the edges thin. river lasts the leather over the form and tacks it fast. mesa sews the welt round the sole and hammers the heel on. A man faking this tally must make 31 pairs without one sole parting at the welt, and the next still gapes where the wax ran thin.
